story_description: As a new user, I want to enter my name and optional email during onboarding so that the app can personalize my experience and greet me by name on subsequent launches.
task_description: Build the UserProfileOnboardingView SwiftUI screen with first name, last name, and optional email fields, including validation, persistence to AppStorage, and welcome back toast functionality.
atom_description: Create a complete SwiftUI view for collecting user profile information during onboarding, with real-time field validation, skip functionality, AppStorage persistence, and personalized welcome toast on subsequent launches.
problem_statement: New users have no way to personalize their Blaze experience. The app cannot greet users by name or remember their identity across sessions, resulting in a generic and impersonal experience that fails to build user engagement.
scope_in: SwiftUI UserProfileOnboardingView with first name, last name, and email text fields
Real-time validation feedback as user types in each field
Skip button that stores empty strings and advances to next screen
Next button that validates and persists profile data to AppStorage
AppStorage persistence for firstName, lastName, and email properties
Welcome back toast notification showing 'Welcome back, {firstName}!' on subsequent app launches
Tooltip explaining data usage: 'Used to personalize your experience'
Navigation integration with OnboardingCoordinator for screen flow
scope_out: Avatar image upload or selection functionality (deferred to future enhancement)
Account creation or cloud sync of profile data
Social login integration (Apple ID, Google, etc.)
Profile editing screen in main app settings (separate task)
Email verification or validation against external services
Profile picture cropping or image processing
assumptions: OnboardingCoordinator exists and manages screen navigation flow
AppStorage is the appropriate persistence mechanism for user preferences
The onboarding flow runs only on first launch or when explicitly reset
SwiftUI Form and TextField components are available in the target macOS version
Toast notification system exists or will be created as a separate component
constraints: Must use AppStorage for persistence (not UserDefaults directly) for SwiftUI binding
Email field must be optional - empty email is valid
First name and last name have no strict validation requirements (can be any non-whitespace string)
Must handle the skip case gracefully without crashing or showing errors
Welcome toast must only appear on non-first launches when firstName is not empty
Must follow existing Blaze UI design patterns and color scheme
functional_requirements: FR1: Display three text fields - First Name, Last Name, and Email (optional) with appropriate placeholder text
FR2: Validate fields as user types - show inline feedback for invalid input (e.g., email format if email is provided)
FR3: Skip button stores empty strings for all three fields in AppStorage and advances to next onboarding screen
FR4: Next button validates required fields, persists all values to AppStorage, and advances to next screen
FR5: On subsequent app launches, if firstName is not empty, display toast notification 'Welcome back, {firstName}!'
FR6: Display tooltip below email field explaining 'Used to personalize your experience'
FR7: Support keyboard navigation - Tab moves between fields, Return submits form
FR8: Integrate with OnboardingCoordinator to receive and emit navigation events
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Form submission and persistence must complete within 50ms
NFR2: View must render without jank during text input (60fps)
NFR3: AppStorage reads must not block UI thread on launch
NFR4: Memory footprint for the view should not exceed 5MB
NFR5: Accessibility - all fields must have proper labels for VoiceOver
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create UserProfileOnboardingView.swift file in Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/Screens/ directory
Step 2: Define @AppStorage properties for firstName, lastName, and email with empty string defaults
Step 3: Create @State properties for local field values and validation state
Step 4: Build Form layout with three TextField views and appropriate styling
Step 5: Implement real-time validation logic using onChange modifiers on text fields
Step 6: Add Skip button with action to save empty strings and call coordinator.advance()
Step 7: Add Next button with validation check and save logic before advancing
Step 8: Create tooltip Text view below email field with 'Used to personalize your experience'
Step 9: Add WelcomeToastModifier view modifier that checks firstName on appear
Step 10: Register UserProfileOnboardingView in OnboardingCoordinator screen enum
Step 11: Add unit tests for validation logic and persistence
Step 12: Add UI tests for form interaction and navigation

OnboardingCoordinator.currentScreen: OnboardingScreen: Returns current screen enum value
UserProfileOnboardingView.init(coordinator: OnboardingCoordinator): Initializes view with coordinator binding

Emit 'onboarding.profile.completed' event with hasEmail: Bool when user taps Next

ui_states: Empty state: All fields empty, Next button disabled (or enabled with warning), Skip button always enabled
Partial state: Some fields filled, real-time validation showing inline feedback
Valid state: Required fields valid, Next button enabled with primary styling
Error state: Invalid email format entered, inline error message below email field
Loading state: Brief spinner while persisting data (if persistence is async)
ui_interactions: User taps First Name field - keyboard appears, field becomes focused with highlight
User types in First Name field - text appears, validation runs on each keystroke
User tabs to Last Name field - focus moves, previous field validation completes
User tabs to Email field - focus moves, optional label visible
User types invalid email - inline error appears: 'Please enter a valid email address'
User corrects email or clears field - error disappears, field shows valid state
User taps Skip button - all fields saved as empty strings, screen advances
User taps Next button with valid data - data persists, screen advances with brief feedback
User taps Next button with invalid data - form scrolls to first error, error highlighted
ui_copy: Tooltip text: 'Used to personalize your experience'
Email validation error: 'Please enter a valid email address'
edge_cases: User enters only whitespace in name fields - treat as empty, allow skip behavior
User enters very long name (500+ characters) - truncate display, store full value
User enters emoji in name fields - allow and display correctly
User enters special characters in email - validate according to RFC 5322
User force quits app during form entry - no data persisted (expected behavior)
User rapidly toggles between Skip and Next - debounce to prevent double navigation
User has previously completed onboarding, returns to profile screen - show existing values
Device has no internet - profile screen works fully offline (no network dependency)
VoiceOver active - all fields announce labels and validation state correctly
failure_modes: AppStorage write fails due to disk full - show error alert, allow retry or skip
OnboardingCoordinator.advance() throws - catch error, log, show generic error message
View fails to load due to missing dependency - show fallback error view with retry
Validation regex throws due to malformed pattern - use permissive fallback, log error
rollback_plan: Revert commit containing UserProfileOnboardingView.swift and WelcomeToastModifier.swift. Remove AppStorage keys from Info.plist if added. Update OnboardingCoordinator to skip profile screen in navigation flow. No data migration needed as new users will simply not have profile data stored.

risks: AppStorage persistence could fail silently on disk-full conditions
Welcome toast timing could conflict with other app launch UI elements
Form validation regex could be too strict and reject valid international names
User data collection without consent could raise privacy concerns
mitigations: Wrap AppStorage writes in do-catch and show user-facing error on failure
Delay welcome toast display by 500ms to allow other launch UI to settle
Use permissive validation that only checks for non-empty after trim for names
Add clear tooltip explaining data usage; email is optional; no cloud sync
risk_register.blast_radius: Limited to onboarding flow and app launch sequence. Does not affect core chat functionality or session management. Only new users see this screen.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If critical issues found post-release, disable profile screen via feature flag and skip directly to next onboarding step. Existing persisted data remains but is not displayed.
